title: Electricity account - overdue notice with disconnection warning
source: synthetic (written for this project; organisations and people are fictional)
notes: Hard negative: alarming wording ('disconnection', 'collection action') but a bill the desk may help with. Synthetic.
summary_en: An overdue balance of $310.55 must be paid or a payment arrangement made by September 25, 2026 to avoid a disconnection notice; the letter offers an arrangement plan by phone.
text:
Lakeshore Hydro (fictional)
OVERDUE NOTICE
Account number: 00-1234-5678
Date: September 11, 2026
Your account has an overdue balance of $310.55. To avoid further collection action, including a disconnection notice, please pay the overdue amount or call us to set up a payment arrangement by September 25, 2026.
If you are having difficulty paying, ask about the Low-income Energy Assistance Program and equal billing. Call 1-800-555-0100, Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.
